title: Rational numbers on a number line
competency: Represent rational numbers as fractions on a number line.

keywords.def: A number that shows a part of a whole, like one-half or three-quarters.
The number on top of a fraction.
The number on the bottom of a fraction. It tells how many equal parts.
A fraction whose numerator is less than its denominator.
A fraction whose numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator.
A whole number and a proper fraction together, like 1 1/2.
A line with 0 in the middle. Positive numbers go right, negative numbers go left.
Two numbers the same distance from 0 but on different sides of 0.

en.text: A fraction shows a part of a whole. The bottom number, the denominator, tells how many equal parts. The top number, the numerator, tells how many parts we take. In a proper fraction the top is smaller. In an improper fraction the top is bigger or equal.

am.text: ክፍልፋይ የአንድ ሙሉ ነገር ክፍልን ያሳያል። ታችኛው ቁጥር ሙሉው በስንት እኩል ክፍሎች እንደተከፈለ ይነግራል። ላይኛው ቁጥር ስንት ክፍሎች እንደወሰድን ይነግራል።

screens.title: Injera for breakfast
screens.ask: An injera is cut into 9 equal pieces. 7 pieces are eaten. What part is eaten?
screens.after:
The injera has 9 equal pieces. That is the denominator.
7 pieces are eaten. That is the numerator.
So 7/9 of the injera is eaten. (9/7 turns it upside down; 2/9 is the part left.)
The book shows the same idea with a DVD cut into 8 parts.

screens.title: Revision on fractions
paras: A fraction is a part of a whole, like one-half or three-quarters.
The numerator is on top. The denominator is on the bottom.
screens.note: Example 1.2: 3/5 of a green area has indigenous plants. Numerator 3, denominator 5.

screens.title: Example 1.2: 3/5 of the green area

shade.label: 3 of 5 equal parts have indigenous plants

screens.after:
The whole is cut into 5 equal parts: denominator 5.
3 parts are covered: numerator 3.
The covered part is 3/5.

screens.title: Kinds of fractions
defs: The numerator is less than the denominator, like 3/7.
The numerator is greater than or equal to the denominator, like 8/5.
A whole number with a proper fraction, like 2 2/5.

screens.title: Sort the fractions: proper, improper or mixed?
items: A whole number and a fraction.
A whole number and a fraction.
screens.why:
Proper: top smaller than bottom. 3/7 (3 < 7) and 1/2 (1 < 2).
Improper: top equal to or bigger than bottom. 8/5 (8 > 5) and 7/3 (7 > 3).
Mixed: a whole number with a proper fraction. 2 2/5 and 3 4/7.
screens.clue: Is the top smaller than the bottom?

screens.title: Improper to mixed: 32/5
steps: 2 is the new numerator; the denominator stays 5.

screens.ask: Change the improper fraction to a mixed fraction: 7/3 = ___
screens.why:
Divide the top by the bottom: 7 ÷ 3 = 2 remainder 1.
The 2 is the whole number.
The remainder 1 is the new top; the bottom stays 3.
So 7/3 = 2 1/3. Check: 2 × 3 + 1 = 7.

screens.ask: Change the improper fraction to a mixed fraction: 27/10 = ___
screens.why:
Divide: 27 ÷ 10 = 2 remainder 7.
The 2 is the whole number.
The remainder 7 is the new top; the bottom stays 10.
So 27/10 = 2 7/10. Check: 2 × 10 + 7 = 27.

screens.ask: Change the mixed fraction to an improper fraction: 4 3/8 = ___
screens.why:
Each whole is 8 eighths, so 4 wholes = 4 × 8 = 32 eighths.
Add the 3 eighths: 32 + 3 = 35 eighths.
Keep the denominator 8.
So 4 3/8 = 35/8. Check: 35 ÷ 8 = 4 remainder 3.
screens.clue: Whole × denominator + numerator, over the same denominator.

en.text: Positive numbers sit to the right of zero and negative numbers to the left. A proper fraction like 2/5 lies between 0 and 1: split that gap into 5 equal parts and count 2. For an improper fraction, change it to a mixed fraction first to find its two whole numbers.

am.text: አዎንታዊ ቁጥሮች ከዜሮ በቀኝ፣ አሉታዊ ቁጥሮች በግራ ይገኛሉ። 2/5 በ0 እና በ1 መካከል ነው፤ ክፍተቱን በ5 እኩል ክፍሎች ከፍለህ 2 ቁጠር። ኢ-ትክክለኛ ክፍልፋይን መጀመሪያ ወደ ድብልቅ ቀይር።

screens.title: What is x?

points.label: x
points.info: is greater than 2 but less than 3. It is not a natural number, whole number or integer.

screens.ask: Tap x. Which numbers is it between?

screens.title: What kind of number is x?
screens.ask: x lies between 2 and 3. What kind of number is it?
opts: None of these: it is between them
screens.after:
x is more than 2 but less than 3.
There is no integer between 2 and 3.
So x is not natural, not whole and not an integer.
It is a rational number, like 5/2 = 2 1/2.
screens.best: None of these: it is between them

screens.title: Locating rational numbers
paras: The set of rational numbers is written ℚ.
Three facts help you place a rational number. Tap each fact below.

screens.title: Three facts for placing a number
items: Positive numbers are right of 0. Negative numbers are left of 0. So −3/4 is left of 0.
A positive proper fraction lies between 0 and 1. So 2/5 is between 0 and 1.
Change an improper fraction to a mixed fraction first. 3/2 = 1 1/2, so it lies between 1 and 2.

points.info: is proper, so it is between 0 and 1. Split 0 to 1 into 5 parts; take the 2nd mark.
= 1 1/2. Between 1 and 2: split into 2 parts, take the 1st mark.
is between −1 and 0. Split into 4 parts; count 3 to the left of 0.

screens.ask: Tap each number to see how it was placed.

screens.title: The number line
defs: A line with 0 in the middle. Positive numbers go right, negative numbers go left.

screens.title: Place 2/5
screens.ask: Place a proper fraction on the number line: tap where 2/5 goes.
screens.why:
2/5 is proper (2 < 5), so it lies between 0 and 1.
The denominator 5 tells you: split 0 to 1 into 5 equal parts.
The numerator 2 tells you: count 2 marks to the right of 0.
That mark is 2/5.

screens.title: Place 3/2
steps: Split the gap from 1 to 2 into 2 equal parts.

screens.title: Place −3/4
screens.ask: Place a negative fraction on the number line: tap where −3/4 goes.
screens.why:
−3/4 is negative, so it is left of 0.
3/4 is proper, so it lies between −1 and 0.
Split 0 to −1 into 4 equal parts.
Count 3 marks to the left of 0. That mark is −3/4.

screens.text: Locate a negative fraction: between which two integers does −9/5 lie?
screens.why:
Change to a mixed fraction: 9 ÷ 5 = 1 remainder 4, so −9/5 = −1 4/5.
−1 4/5 is past −1, but not yet at −2.
So it lies between −2 and −1.
(−1 and 0 is tempting, but −9/5 is bigger in size than 1.)
screens.clue: Change −9/5 to a mixed fraction first.
screens.worked:
9 ÷ 5 = 1 remainder 4, so 9/5 = 1 4/5.
So −9/5 = −1 4/5.
On the line, go 1 unit left of 0 to −1, then 4/5 more.
That is between −2 and −1.

screens.title: Place 5/6
screens.ask: Place a proper fraction on the number line: tap where 5/6 goes.
screens.why:
5/6 is proper (5 < 6), so it is between 0 and 1.
Split 0 to 1 into 6 equal parts.
Count 5 marks to the right of 0.
That mark is 5/6, just one mark before 1.

screens.text: Decimals on the number line: true or false? −8.85 lies to the left of −8.8.
screens.why:
Write both with two decimal places: −8.85 and −8.80.
In size, 8.85 is bigger than 8.80.
On the negative side, a bigger size is further left.
So −8.85 is left of −8.8: true.
screens.clue: Compare 8.85 and 8.80. Which is further from 0?

screens.ask: Place an improper negative fraction: tap where −7/3 goes.
screens.why:
Change to a mixed fraction: 7 ÷ 3 = 2 remainder 1, so −7/3 = −2 1/3.
It is negative, so go left: past −2.
Split −2 to −3 into 3 equal parts.
Take 1 mark left of −2. That is −7/3.
screens.clue: Change −7/3 to a mixed number first.

en.text: Two numbers are opposites when they are the same distance from zero but on different sides. 3/2 and −3/2 are opposites. To find the opposite of a number, change its sign.

am.text: ሁለት ቁጥሮች ከዜሮ እኩል ርቀት ላይ ሆነው በተለያየ ጎን ሲገኙ ተቃራኒዎች ናቸው። 3/2 እና −3/2 ተቃራኒዎች ናቸው። የቁጥርን ተቃራኒ ለማግኘት ምልክቱን ቀይር።

screens.title: Above and below the sea
screens.ask: A place 125 m above sea level is +125 m. The Danakil Depression is 125 m below. Which number is it?
screens.after:
Below sea level is the negative direction.
125 m below is −125 m.
−125 and 125 are the same distance from 0, on opposite sides.
They are called opposites.

screens.title: Opposites
screens.ask: Tap both points. How far is each from 0?

screens.title: Opposites
paras: Two rational numbers are opposite if they are the same distance from 0, on different sides of 0.

screens.title: Opposite
defs: Two numbers the same distance from 0 but on different sides of 0.

screens.title: Opposites: match each number to its opposite
screens.why:
The opposite has the same size and the other sign.
4/5 ↔ −4/5 and −2/3 ↔ 2/3.
2 3/5 ↔ −2 3/5 and −3 4/7 ↔ 3 4/7.
Check: each pair adds to 0.
screens.clue: The opposite has the same size but the other sign.

screens.why:
The opposite is the same distance from 0, on the other side.
−7/2 is 3 1/2 units left of 0.
The opposite is 3 1/2 units right of 0.
So the opposite is 7/2. Check: −7/2 + 7/2 = 0.

screens.text: Opposites: true or false? The opposite of 0 is 0.
screens.why:
0 is 0 units from 0.
The only number 0 units from 0 is 0 itself.
Also 0 + 0 = 0.
So 0 is its own opposite: true.

screens.text: Opposites on the number line: x and y are opposites. x is 2 1/4 units to the left of 0. What is y?
screens.why:
x is left of 0, so x = −2 1/4.
Opposites are the same distance from 0, on different sides.
y is 2 1/4 units right of 0.
So y = 2 1/4. (−2 1/4 is x itself, not its opposite.)
screens.clue: Opposites are the same distance from 0, on different sides.

items.text: Number line: B is between 1 and 3.5, closer to 1. Select a reasonable value for B.
items.why:
B must be bigger than 1 and smaller than 3.5.
0.5 and −0.2 are less than 1. 3.6 is more than 3.5.
Only 2 is between 1 and 3.5.
The midpoint is 2.25, so 2 is also the closer side to 1.
items.clue: B must be bigger than 1 and smaller than 3.5.

items.text: Locate a fraction: between what consecutive integers does 8/5 lie?
items.why:
Change to a mixed fraction: 8 ÷ 5 = 1 remainder 3.
So 8/5 = 1 3/5.
1 3/5 is more than 1 and less than 2.
Answer: between 1 and 2.

items.text: Locate a negative fraction: between what consecutive integers does −9/5 lie?
items.why:
9 ÷ 5 = 1 remainder 4, so −9/5 = −1 4/5.
−1 4/5 is past −1 but not yet −2.
So it lies between −2 and −1.

items.ask: Change the improper fraction to a mixed fraction: 32/5 = ___
items.why:
Divide: 32 ÷ 5 = 6 remainder 2.
The 6 is the whole number.
The remainder 2 is the new top; the bottom stays 5.
So 32/5 = 6 2/5. Check: 6 × 5 + 2 = 32.

items.ask: Exercise 1.1 Q4 c: place a negative fraction. Tap where −5/6 goes.
items.why:
−5/6 is negative, so it is left of 0.
5/6 is proper, so it lies between −1 and 0.
Split 0 to −1 into 6 equal parts.
Count 5 marks left of 0. That mark is −5/6.

items.text: Decimals on the number line: true or false? −8.85 is to the left of −8.8.
items.why:
Write −8.8 as −8.80.
8.85 is bigger in size than 8.80.
For negatives, the bigger size is further left.
So −8.85 < −8.8: true.

test.ask: Place an improper fraction: tap where 4/3 goes.
test.why:
4 ÷ 3 = 1 remainder 1, so 4/3 = 1 1/3.
It lies between 1 and 2.
Split 1 to 2 into 3 equal parts.
Take the first mark after 1. That is 4/3.

test.text: Locate a negative fraction: between which integers does −3/5 lie?
test.why:
3/5 is proper (3 < 5), so it is less than 1 in size.
−3/5 is negative, so it is left of 0.
It has not reached −1.
So it lies between −1 and 0.

Keep the size, change the sign.
2 3/5 is right of 0, so its opposite is left of 0.
The opposite is −2 3/5 (= −13/5 = −2.6).
Check: 2 3/5 + (−2 3/5) = 0.

test.text: Kinds of fractions: which fraction is improper?
test.why:
Improper means the top is equal to or bigger than the bottom.
9/4: 9 > 4, so it is improper.
4/9 and 1/2 are proper. 3 1/2 is a mixed fraction.
Answer: 9/4.

test.ask: Change the mixed fraction to an improper fraction: 3 2/5 = ___
test.why:
Each whole is 5 fifths: 3 × 5 = 15 fifths.
Add the 2 fifths: 15 + 2 = 17.
Keep the denominator 5.
So 3 2/5 = 17/5.

screens.text: Divide the numerator by the denominator.
